title: RBI Monetary Penalty Order - Hinduja Leyland Finance Limited
description: RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹6.20 lakh on Hinduja Leyland Finance Limited for non-compliance with directions on 'Pricing of Microfinance Loans' and 'Securitisation of Standard Assets'. The company failed to put in place a Board-approved policy on pricing of microfinance loans and engaged in synthetic securitization activities.
